meaning:
εὔφημος, -ον
(εὖ, φήμη), [in Sm.: Psa.63:6 ;]
primarily, utter­ing words or sounds of good omen, hence,
1. avoiding ill-omened words, religiously silent.
2. fair-sounding, auspicious (R, mg., gracious): Php.4:8.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Finally, brothers, whatever things are true, whatever things are honorable, whatever things are just, whatever things are pure, whatever things are lovely…
